name: Amanda's Native Garden
notes: Native perennial nursery (Ellen Folts). Pollinator Partnership checklist: forbs, grasses/sedges and woodland plants yes; shrubs/trees and seed no. Listed by Wild Ones WNY and Healthy Yards Monroe County; also appears at regional plant sales.
sources: Healthy Yards Monroe County — Native Plant Sellers
Pollinator Partnership — Native Plant Nurseries & Seed Vendors for New York State (June 2024)

name: White Oak Nursery
notes: Native TREES AND SHRUBS only — the Pollinator Partnership capability checklist marks forbs, grasses/sedges, woodland plants and seed as 'No'. By appointment only. Also supplies pre-order stock for the Wild Ones HGCNY fall sale.
sources: Healthy Yards Monroe County — Native Plant Sellers
Wild Ones HGCNY — Native Plant Sales
Pollinator Partnership — Native Plant Nurseries & Seed Vendors for New York State (June 2024)

name: The Plantsmen Nursery
notes: States it grows the greatest diversity of native plants available in NY, spray-free (no pesticides, herbicides or fungicides). Near Ithaca. Pollinator Partnership checklist: forbs, grasses/sedges, woodland plants and shrubs/trees all yes; no seed.
sources: Healthy Yards Monroe County — Native Plant Sellers
Pollinator Partnership — Native Plant Nurseries & Seed Vendors for New York State (June 2024)

notes: Native plant nursery (Deanna English) south-east of Ithaca.
sources: Healthy Yards Monroe County — Native Plant Sellers

name: Royal Fern Nursery & Sweet Flag Herbs
notes: Fern and herb focus; listed as operating partly as a pop-up. Confirm whether the Glasgow Rd address is open to visitors.

name: Eastern Monarch Butterfly Farm
address_note: Sells at the Clarence Hollow Farmers Market, 8am–1pm. Confirm market season and day.
notes: Milkweed and monarch-habitat focus.

name: Swiftwater Organic Farm
notes: Organic grower listed among WNY native-focused nurseries. Website in the source list appears to contain a typo — find the working URL before publishing.

name: Urban Roots Cooperative Garden Market
notes: Community-owned garden centre carrying a native selection alongside general nursery stock.

name: Masterson's Garden Center
notes: General garden centre listed by Wild Ones WNY as carrying natives — expect cultivars alongside straight species.

name: The English Gardener
notes: Garden centre listed by Wild Ones WNY as carrying natives — expect cultivars alongside straight species.

name: Mill Street Gardens
address_note: Street address not captured during seeding — fill in before publishing.
notes: Publishes a native plant inventory page for the Finger Lakes / Central NY region — a good early candidate for inventory sampling in S5.
sources: Mill Street Gardens — Native Plant Inventory

name: Finger Lakes Nursery
address_note: Described as a 14-acre homestead near the southern end of Cayuga Lake; exact address not captured.
notes: Edible, perennial and multi-use plants selected for the region — berry bushes, native shrubs, fruit and nut trees. Strong overlap with the food-forest use case.

name: Edible Acres
notes: Permaculture nursery focused on perennial edibles, many of them native; propagation-heavy, sells bare-root, cuttings, bulbs and seed. Local pickup arranged by email for Finger Lakes-area customers. Self-describes as serving the Finger Lakes even though Tompkins County sits in ESD's Southern Tier region.
season_note: Offerings update March 1 for spring bare-root and September 1 for fall bare-root. Fall leans trees and shrubs; spring leans herbaceous perennials and grasses.

name: Monroe County SWCD — Conservation Tree & Shrub Program
order_window: Pre-order in winter; distribution in April at the district office. 2026 pre-orders are closed.
season_note: Pre-order program only — nothing is sold walk-in.
notes: Bare-root seedlings, transplants and other plant materials in species native or naturalized to New York State. Species sheets are published in a public Google Drive folder each season.
sources: Monroe County SWCD — Tree & Shrub Program

name: Erie County SWCD — Tree and Shrub Seedling Sale
order_window: Annual winter pre-order; specific dates not published on the programs page — confirm with the district.
notes: Annual sale and distribution of evergreen and deciduous seedlings and transplants for conservation of natural resources.

name: Ontario County SWCD — Tree and Shrub Seedling Sale
order_window: Annual winter pre-order; a third-party roundup lists a historic order deadline in early March — confirm the current year's date with the district.
sources: Genesee Valley Conservancy — Tree and Shrub Seedling Sales

name: Livingston County SWCD — Tree and Shrub Seedling Sale
order_window: Annual winter pre-order; a third-party roundup lists a historic order deadline in mid-March — confirm the current year's date with the district.
address_note: District office address not captured during seeding — fill in before publishing.
sources: Genesee Valley Conservancy — Tree and Shrub Seedling Sales

name: NYSDEC Saratoga Tree Nursery — Seedling Sale
order_window: Statewide seedling program with a spring order deadline (a third-party roundup lists late March historically) — confirm the current year on DEC's site.
notes: State-run nursery selling low-cost native tree and shrub seedlings in bundles to NY landowners. Note dec.ny.gov 403s plain urllib — fetch via the browser pane or full headers (HANDOFF §18).
sources: Genesee Valley Conservancy — Tree and Shrub Seedling Sales

name: Buffalo & Erie County Public Library — Seed Library
venue_hint: Central Library Launch Pad, downtown Buffalo
season_note: Seeds checked out in person with Launch Pad staff; borrow up to 4 packets at a time. Returns encouraged but not required.
notes: Collection is community-donated and aims to showcase native species alongside vegetables, herbs and flowers. Native share is likely small — sample before claiming coverage.
sources: Buffalo & Erie County Public Library — Seed Library

name: Geneva Public Library — Seed Library
notes: Public library seed library in the Finger Lakes. Native share not yet checked.

name: Niagara Falls Public Library — Vegetation Station Seed Library
notes: Run in cooperation with Grassroots Gardens of WNY, which donates seed. Native share not yet checked.
sources: Niagara Falls Public Library — Seed Library

name: Prairie Moon Nursery
notes: Mail-order nursery, since 1982, for native plants and seed of the Midwest, Northeast, Great Lakes and mid-Atlantic; 700+ species with published germination codes. Prime candidate for the first automated feed adapter in S9.

name: Ernst Conservation Seeds
notes: Founded 1964; described as the largest native seed producer and supplier in the eastern United States, propagating hundreds of native and naturalized species on 9,000+ acres in north-western PA. Bulk seed and regional ecotype mixes — the practical source for meadow or understory sowing near WNY.

name: Izel Native Plants
notes: Consolidates the inventories of wholesale-only growers into retail mail order; stock sold as plugs, quarts and seed. Because it aggregates other growers, provenance varies by item — record the actual grower where the listing states it.

name: Wild Seed Project
notes: Maine nonprofit selling wild-type Northeast native seed in small packets with strong propagation guidance.
sources: Pollinator Partnership — Native Plant Nurseries & Seed Vendors for New York State (June 2024)

name: Finger Lakes Native Plant Society
address_note: Meets at Cornell Botanic Gardens' Nevin Center; no retail location.
season_note: Members' seed exchange runs seasonally; plants are sold at the spring sale and the Grow Native! festival.
notes: Supplies plants two ways: a members' seed exchange (free) and its plant sales. Whether non-members may take part in the seed exchange is not stated on the site — confirm before describing it as open to all.

name: Cornell Botanic Gardens
address_note: Sales are held at the Plant Production Facility, 397 Forest Home Dr.
notes: Sells native plants at its spring sale, run in partnership with the Finger Lakes Native Plant Society.
sources: Cornell Events — Spring Native Plant Sale 2026

name: Wild Ones Habitat Gardening in Central NY
address_note: No retail location; sales are held in Westvale (Syracuse), with the address published in the chapter newsletter before each sale.
notes: Volunteer chapter selling member-grown natives at spring and fall sales, plus pre-orders for trees and shrubs supplied by White Oak Nursery. Cash or check only.
sources: Wild Ones HGCNY — Native Plant Sales

name: Color Brighton Green
address_note: No retail location; its sale is held at Buckland Park, 1435 Westfall Rd, Brighton.
notes: Community group whose native plant sale gathers multiple seed-raised native growers in one place. Confirm whether the sale recurs.
sources: Wild Ones HGCNY — Native Plant Sales

name: Butterfly Effect
notes: Pollinator Partnership checklist: forbs, grasses/sedges and shrubs/trees yes; woodland plants and seed no.
sources: Pollinator Partnership — Native Plant Nurseries & Seed Vendors for New York State (June 2024)

name: Southern Tier Consulting
notes: One of very few regional sources marked YES across the whole Pollinator Partnership checklist — forbs, grasses/sedges, woodland plants, shrubs/trees AND seed. Wetland/restoration focus. Note the name: despite 'Southern Tier', Allegany County is in ESD's Western New York region.
sources: Pollinator Partnership — Native Plant Nurseries & Seed Vendors for New York State (June 2024)

name: Schuyler County SWCD — Green Arbor Program
order_window: Orders taken January through the first week in March; pickup in April.
address_note: Lee Harlan Soil and Water Conservation Center, at Meads Hill Rd and County Road 16.
notes: Has supplied over 750,000 low-cost trees and shrubs. Evergreens, deciduous trees and shrubs, berries and fruit trees, plus fertilizer tablets and bluebird houses. Bare-root seedlings and transplants.

name: Tioga County SWCD — Tree and Shrub Seedling Sale
order_window: Orders January through mid-April, first-come first-served; the district asks for orders of 100+ seedlings before March 1. Cash or check at time of order.
notes: Drive-thru pickup at the Owego office. Confirm species quantities by phone before ordering.

name: Broome County SWCD — Tree & Shrub Seedling Program
order_window: Annual winter pre-order; dates not captured during seeding.
address_note: Directory listings disagree between '1163 Front Street' and '1163 Upper Front Street' — confirm.

order_window: Annual pre-order; dates not captured during seeding.

name: Chemung County SWCD — Tree Program

name: Broome County Public Library — Seed Library
season_note: Runs for the growing season; seed cart sits across from the front public printer.
address_note: No library card necessary — open and free to the public.
notes: Three packets per visit, no need to return them. Stock is donated vegetable, herb and flower seed; NATIVE SHARE IS UNCONFIRMED and probably small. Sample the actual cabinet before crediting it with any native species (S5). Cornell Cooperative Extension of Broome County donated ~10,000 packets of retail surplus in 2025, which is exactly the kind of stock that carries no natives.
sources: Broome County Public Library — Our Seed Library is Back
